title: Seasonal conditioning improves distribution-based hydrological similarity: reproduction materials
description: Version 1.0.0 of the reproducibility software and derived inputs for monthly conditional Wasserstein hydrological similarity. Includes fixed station-separated evaluations, regional comparisons, GEnS temperate-zone analyses, monthly location/shape ablation, plotting scripts and a raw Caravan rebuild workflow. MIT applies to original software only; derived data retain source rights as described in RIGHTS.md and DATA_PROVENANCE.md.
